name: ai-chrome-remote
description: A TypeScript starter for AI-controllable Chrome extensions with MCP and Native Messaging.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:extension && npm run build:native && npm run copy-static
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check dist/native-host/src/index.js && node --check dist/native-host/src/native-messaging.js && node --check dist/native-host/src/invoke.js && node --check dist/native-host/src/mcp-server.js && node --check dist/native-host/src/install-chrome-host.js && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs
